title: Pegboard hook (catalog): steel hook replica
subtitle: Bent 5.53 mm wire + anti-rotation pin, traced from your photos · hung on a 1/4" pegboard (1" grid) · X out from the board, Z up · millimetres

dims.label: Room behind the back leg (max board thickness)

scale_note: Real size. The wire is your caliper reading (5.53 mm); every other dimension is measured off your tape photo (1 inch = 245 px), so it is good to roughly ±1 mm. The pegboard is a generic 1/4" board, lined up on the pin.
notes: Catalog part: a printable copy of your steel pegboard hook, traced from your tape photo (within about 1 mm) with the wire at your 5.53 mm caliper reading. It prints lying on its side in PETG with no supports (0.4 mm flat on the bed side; a brim helps). At 5.5 mm, plastic is much floppier than steel, so it suits light things (keys, cables, small tools). This hook is also where the shared peg sizes come from (tools/pegboard.py); the fit test for those is its own project, pegboard-fit-test. Note: its S-bend slightly overlaps a nominal 1/4" hole, like the real hook seems to; check it on your board.
